description: Builds a below-market offer worksheet for one address from cached public-records values (MAO = ARV × 70% − repairs − assignment fee), with repair scenarios and a basic state-rule overlay. Included with Pro ($149/month), not Lead Alerts. No per-call charge; send header X-Property-Plan-Key.

address.description: Street address to look up in the public-records cache.

city.description: Optional city to disambiguate the address.

state.description: USPS two-letter code, DC, or PR.
